scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

entrypoints.bindings: bindings() -> frozen source data; no live effects
entrypoints.transport: transport(b) -> (Commands class, namespace); Commands(out,Stop()).exact(argv,timeout=30,check=True). Caller must provide separately reviewed exact argv scope. It does not acquire a lock or invoke a guard by itself.
entrypoints.process_source: process_source(normal,packet) -> source for unchanged root full census plus pgrp/session rows and BFD publisher identities
entrypoints.validate_process: validate_process(report,normal,b,challenge,caller,command_pids) -> true; all pure; preserves original census predicates
entrypoints.validate_result: validate_result(result,b) -> authenticated command receipt values; pure complete ordered14-command/proof/raw/OCI result consumer; never parentjoin/currentclearance

cleanup_actor: RESULT.cleanup_actor = actual pid,birth,mutex_fd. Parent must save positive direct join then separate actual observer must prove process/group/FD/mutex/cgroup state.
actor_gaps: Original run/inspect sudo Docker child PID/birth not persisted by custom subprocess.run; do not invent.
Capture-parent/held-input/publisher transient source writers do not all have persisted birth receipts; full root publisher/actor census and exact no-unlisted Root attestation remain mandatory.
